verdict.rationale: The evidence shows API-style reference material for runes such as $derived, $effect and $state.raw, and indirectly shows a runnable playground, since the CLI can create a SvelteKit project from a playground URL. Nothing ties the two together into an interactive API reference with embedded runnable examples. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an interactive API reference, runnable examples embedded in reference pages, a first-party description of the playground itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
